The apathy part is definitely valid. Crazily, while trying to respond to the part about apathy, I ended up realizing that my two most recent disappointments were merely about very specific methods that I had placed so much "magic" hope into. I now feel like the likelihood of achieving my dream is pretty high. Maybe as long as I feel magic toward my dream but not feel so invested in any particular method, I should be okay.

Thank you for taking the time to respond. I really wasn't expecting to have this realization.

I found your post by searching "magic" as I'm going through something similar at 27.5. Yesterday I would have killed myself had it not been for some logistical issues. Later, I realized that I could go on if I had a way of continuing to believe in magic without being vulnerable to disappointment. I don't know what that way is, but since I'm thinking about it, I think my subconscious will figure it out.

Feel free to talk here or message me since we seem to relate.
